text:
tara: Quick design check: new compact alert preview for SLO editor. Mock: https://img.redwood.test/compact-preview.png. Two UX tradeoffs: A) show channel list as numbered priority stack (always visible) vs B) show up to 2 inline chips + "+N" expand. B keeps density but hides order. Thoughts?

omar: I'm leaning numbered stack for editors (clarity) and chips + +N for small cards. Could we do hybrid: show numbers in the expanded state and keep chips inline collapsed?

lucy: Accessibility: if we collapse order behind +N, screen readers still need to expose order. Add an offscreen ordered list with full labels when collapsed. Also suppression pill color currently fails contrast on light mode.

sam: Microcopy: for suppression, options: "Muted until 11:00", "Suppressed  schedule", "Silenced". My pick: "Muted until 11:00" for end-time clarity. For fallback routing show a muted line: "fallback: regional" not an icon-only affordance.

omar: UI affordance idea: +N button should be `role=button` with `aria-expanded` and announce "Show 3 more channels, priority order included". Keyboard: focus should land on first newly revealed channel.

tara: Plan: hybrid display; chips inline for compact, always-show stack in editor. @lucy please add exact contrast tokens and offscreen SR snippet. @sam create 3 microcopy variants and prefer "Muted until <time>" as default. @omar prototype +N aria text and keyboard flow. Sync Thurs 9am.
